punchline: In 1998 a label that marks only dividing cells showed new neurons in the brains of adult humans.
thirty_sec: Eriksson, Gage and colleagues examined post-mortem brain tissue from patients treated with BrdU and found newborn neurons in the dentate gyrus, showing that adult human brains can still make neurons.
question: Which belief at work or at home has gone unchallenged mainly because nobody measured it?
key_contrast: Neurons never replaced in adults versus new neurons found in the hippocampus.
